sections.title: Section 1: Moving Company Service Report

(adjective). nhân ba lần (x3)

(noun). dao kéo, thìa

(noun). ấm nước

antique

(adjective). đồ cổ

(verb). chú ý

confused

(adjective). bối rối

(verb). tái định cư

schedule

(verb). lên thời khóa biểu, hẹn giờ, sắp xếp

luggage

(noun). hành lý

(noun). cầu thang bộ trong một tầng

(verb). kết thúc

(verb). tụ tập, quây quần

(noun). phòng chờ, phòng giải lao

(noun). sảnh chính

(noun). đại biểu

(noun). khách

(noun). thịt nướng

(noun). phí tham dự

(noun). chương trình

(noun). đám đông

weary

(adjective). mệt mỏi

He's feeling weary after a long day of work.

skip

(verb). bỏ qua

refreshment

(noun). đồ giải khát

Please help yourself to some light refreshment we have prepared on the table.

(verb). thích

The bear is very fond of honey.

in advance

(adverb). trước

Planning your meals out in advance can help you to develop healthier eating habits.

remark

(noun). lời phê bình, bình luận

mingle

(verb). hòa vào đám đông, nói chuyện xã giao

(noun). đặc sản, món ăn đặc trưng

Phở is one of the most popular specialties of Vietnam.

forgetful

(adjective). lơ đãng, hay quên

She's so forgetful that she doesn't remember where she puts her bag.

sections.title: Section 3: General Course Details
sections.html:
defining

(adjective). mang tính xác định, thể hiện rõ nhất tính chất của cái gì đó

The defining moment of his life was when he had to decide on which path he should take.

proficiency

(noun). sự thông thạo

Scoring more than 7.5 overall on the IELTS shows that you have a high level of proficiency in English.

compulsory

(adjective). bắt buộc

Although it's not compulsory to wear a mask in public, you should still do it anyway.

requirement

(noun). yêu cầu

For most office jobs nowadays, the most basic requirement is a university degree.

flexible

(adjective). linh hoạt

Having a flexible work schedule allows me to have more time for my study.

full-time

(adjective). toàn thời gian

Being a mom is a full-time job.

freshman

(noun). sinh viên năm nhất

I met most of my good friends when I was a freshman in college.

off-campus

(adjective). ngoài khuôn viên trường

Modern technology allows students to study online from off-campus.

laboratory

(noun). phòng thí nghiệm

Scientists are working tirelessly in the laboratory to find the cure for the disease.

detective

(noun). thám tử, điều tra viên

The detective is trying to find clues to help him solve the mystery.

experimental

(adjective). mang tính thí nghiệm, dùng để thí nghiệm

The new vaccine is still experimental, meaning it's not safe enough for the public yet.

damaged

(adjective). bị hư hại

The apartment was heavily damaged.

med school

(noun). trường y

It normally takes a lot of money and time to graduate from med school and become a doctor.

be under construction

(adjective). đang được xây dựng

This building is currently under construction.

enrolment

(noun). việc đăng kí môn học

Enrolment for the new courses starts today, so that's why many students are lining up.

worthwhile

(adjective). đáng giá, đáng thời gian

Although we don't get paid for doing volunteer work, the work itself is quite worthwhile.

sophomore

(adjective). năm hai, sinh viên/học sinh năm hai

In sophomore year in high school, I was having a good time with friends and didn't have to worry about exams or graduation.

put off

(verb). dời lại, hoãn lại

He's been putting off doing the dishes for several days now.

balance

(verb). cân bằng

Every working parent knows how difficult it is to balance their work life and their home life.

theory-based

(adjective). mang tính lý thuyết

The course was too theory-based and not practical enough for me, since all we did in there was reading books and writing essays.

complain

(verb). than phiền

If you want to complain about something at work, you should put it in this box.

department

(noun). khoa

The Department of Health has updated their guidelines on how to prevent to spread of the virus.

allowance

(noun). khoản tiền dành cho việc gì đó

When I was a kid, my dad used to give me allowance every morning before school.

strict

(adjective). nghiêm khắc, nghiêm ngặt

You shouldn't be too strict with your children, or they'll become afraid of you.

major

(noun). chuyên ngành

Her major is accounting, as she wants to be an accountant after she graduates.

well-rounded

(adjective). toàn diện

I always like trying new things so I can become a more well-rounded person.

veterinarian

(noun). bác sĩ thú y

I love animals so much, so my dream job is to become a veterinarian.

definitely

(adjective). tất nhiên

I believe that you can definitely do it, so don't worry so much.

statistics

(noun). môn xác suất thống kê

I'm not good at math and numbers, so I'm finding this statistics class very hard.

sections.title: Section 4: How To Choose Flooring Materials
sections.html:
flooring

(noun). vật liệu lát sàn nhà, làm sàn nhà

It's wise to pick a flooring material that goes well with the room.

artificial

(adjective). nhân tạo

If you want flowers in your house to last for a long time, just get some artificial ones.

mixed blessing

(noun). một thứ vừa có lợi vừa có hại

Fast food is something of a mixed blessing because it tastes good but it's so unhealthy.

undergo

(verb). đi qua, trải qua

He had to undergo several surgeries last year.

for all intents and purposes

(adverb). almost completely, almost totally

Here in Finland, tap water and bottled water are, for all intents and purposes, similar. You can drink both.

alike

(adjective). giống nhau

These two dogs are actually quite alike.

lumber

(noun). gỗ

All this lumber will be used to build a new house.

quarry

(verb). khai thác đá

They are calling in more people to help quarry as much marble as possible.

seasoned

(adjective). (gỗ) đã để khô, thích hợp để được sử dụng

The firewood needs to be left outside until they are seasoned and ready to be used.

polish

(verb). đánh bóng

I haven't used this pair of shoes for a long time, so I need to polish them again before I put them on.

installation

(noun). việc lắp đặt, cài đặt

I called a plumber to help me with the installation of the washing machine.

aesthetics

(noun). vẻ đẹp, mặt thẩm mỹ, giá trị thẩm mỹ

The aesthetics of this painting lies in how peaceful it feels.

layout

(noun). bố cục

The layout of this living room is pretty simple.

property

(noun). đặc tính, đặc điểm

Three important properties of drinking water is that it doesn't have any color, smell, or specific taste.

mood

(noun). không khí, tâm trạng

The mood in the meeting room was so tense.

texture

(noun). kết cấu, cách cấu tạo

I really like this silk fabric because the texture is amazingly smooth.

grain pattern

(noun). hoạ tiết thớ gỗ, vòng gỗ

I like the wooden floor, but I'm not a fan of the grain patterns on it.

formula

(noun). công thức

I hate math because I'm not good at remembering different formulas.

subjective

(adjective). mang tính chủ quan, thiếu khách quan

You can like something that others don't, because taste is completely subjective.

ambiguous

(adjective). đa nghĩa, không rõ ràng

This picture is so ambiguous that I don't know if I'm looking at a rabbit or a duck.

verbal

(adjective). bằng từ ngữ, bằng miệng

Most of the communication we have daily is verbal.

description

(noun). mô tả

To get customers to pay attention to your product, you need to write a good description.

approximately

(adverb). khoảng, xấp xỉ

The number Pi is approximately equal to 3.

surface

(noun). bề mặt

I want my dining table to have a smooth surface, but not slippery.

reflect

(verb). phản chiếu

The glass reflects the light right into my eye.

absorb

(verb). hấp thụ, hút vào

If you wear a black shirt out in the sun, you're going to feel so much hotter because the color back absorbs the most light and heat.

dense

(adjective). đặc

Honey is much denser than water.

velvet

(noun). vải nhung

Velvet is one of my most favorite types of fabric, simply because it feels so soft to touch.

warp

(verb). bị biến dạng, bị giảm chất lượng

Over time, the floor begins to warp and crack.

ubiquitous

(adjective). thường thấy, có ở khắp nơi

ATMs are so ubiquitous nowadays, that you can find many machines next to each other at any supermarket.

contrast

(noun). độ tương phản, sự tương phản

There's a sharp contrast between the brightness of the flower and the dark background.

consult

(verb). trao đổi, nhờ sự cố vấn của ai đó

Before any major surgery, the patient usually has to consult with the doctor several times.

enhance

(verb). cải thiện, làm trở nên tốt hơn

As a team, we need to work together to enhance the performance of our company.

preserve

(verb). bảo quản

Putting fruits and vegetables in the fridge helps to preserve them and keep them fresh for longer.

creation

(noun). quá trình tạo ra, sự tạo ra

People have different ideas regarding the creation of the world.

rule of thumb

(noun). phương pháp đo lường hay đánh giá cái gì đó dựa trên kinh nghiệm chứ không dựa trên sự chính xác

A common rule of thumb to measure how much water to add to the rice is to use your finger.
